description:
One bounded reclamation page. The canonical owner retains its continuation;
`after` observes that frontier and absence completes the current pass.
Edge-heavy versions keep their candidate at the cursor until its bounded edge
pages have been removed, so a caller does not lose the orphan frontier.

after.description: Observed canonical frontier; no caller supplies or resets this cursor.

edges.description: Structural edges removed in bounded pages.

examined.description: Candidate intervals whose fresh retention decisions were examined.

versions.description: Immutable versions removed after their last membership and edge disappeared.

title: SourceReclamationPage
